column1: # High-PM sky-position regression corpus for the direction cascade.
# Published ICRS J2000 positions from SIMBAD (fetched 2026-07-02);
# every row except xi UMa carries SIMBAD's Gaia-EDR3-propagated
# coordinate (coo_bibcode 2020yCat.1350....0G), so a mismatch beyond
# tol_arcsec means an epoch-propagation defect (PM sign, cos delta
# convention, dt direction), not a source discrepancy.
# tol_arcsec rationale: Gaia-tier rows use 0.5" — sign/convention
# errors on these PMs produce tens-to-hundreds of arcsec, while the
# honest error budget (perspective acceleration <= 0.15", float32
# container ~0.02") stays well under. xi UMa is the athyg_printed
# tier-3 canonical (no Gaia source, HIP 55203 excluded from HIP2);
# its AT-HYG GJ-anchored position is only good to a couple of arcsec
# against SIMBAD's UCAC4 coordinate, so it pins at 3.0".
# lookup: hip where the AT-HYG row carries one; xi UMa's row carries
# neither HIP nor Gaia (that is precisely why it routes tier 3), so it
# is addressed by proper name and its hip cell is blank.
